title: Relay friction: Codex brief sets GOCACHE under .scratch; no ui role in relay-run; spec names data source

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S83 relay (run-20261023-120600-fe40): the Codex sandbox cannot write ~/Library/Caches/go-build, so the first implementer round stopped at 'operation not permitted'; the brief should set GOCACHE under .scratch. The first brief made Codex ask an owner question about 'matrix rows' instead of reading design.md:152, so a spec should name its data source. relay-run has no ui role, so the UI pass was recorded as reviewer. slicer start and done worked in the Codex sandbox with no .git denial. Candidates for slicer or the agents repo; check ownership before filing there.
